Meta.siteDescription: NFC business cards. Tap, save the contact, stay connected.

Landing.title: One tap. All your contact details.
Landing.subtitle: An NFC business card that opens your digital profile on any phone, no app needed. Update it any time without changing the card.

tap.title: Tap to share
tap.description: People just tap the card on their phone. No app, no sign-in.

save.title: Save the contact instantly
save.description: The Save Contact button adds you straight to iPhone and Android contacts.

update.title: Always up to date
update.description: Change your title, number or links any time. The same card keeps working.

Login.title: Sign in
Login.sendFailed: We couldn't send the code. Try again in a moment.
Login.codeSent: We sent a code to {email}. Check your spam folder too.
Login.codeInvalid: The code is wrong or has expired.

invalid.title: Invalid card
invalid.description: We don't recognise the code on this card. Please contact the card owner or your supplier.

inactive.title: Card not active
inactive.description: This card has been deactivated or isn't linked to a profile yet.

Activate.chooseProfile: Choose the profile this card opens

Links.title: Links
Links.description: Social and custom links shown on your profile. Drag to change the order.
Links.noProfile: Create a profile first, then add links to it.

Links.labelHint: Optional. Leave empty to show the platform name.
